canonical_term: Guild Wars 2: End of Dragons launch campaign
definition: The selected Guild Wars 2 expansion campaign that ArenaNet announced as live on 28 February 2022.
cultural_caution: A live-service release boundary, not the whole Guild Wars franchise or all subsequent End of Dragons story chapters/patches.

supports: End of Dragons live release and Story Journal start

definition: The returning faction ArenaNet selected as central to the End of Dragons plot; the article describes its evolution after extended time in the Mists.
cultural_caution: A faction, not a collective-character node. Its prior Living World history is context and not merged wholesale into this pass.

citations.locator: Enter The Aetherblades and Mist Connections sections
supports: Aetherblades' End of Dragons centrality and Mists-era evolution

definition: A named realm in which the Aetherblades survive for years; the official article links it to echoes, Mai Trin's repeated reliving of mistakes and gained revenant powers, and Ankka's repeated echo-killing.
cultural_caution: The source describes particular narrative effects; it does not justify a universal rule about every being who visits the Mists.

citations.locator: Mist Connections; Ankka. Ank-ka.; The Haunting of Mai Trin sections
supports: Mists context for Aetherblades, Ankka, and Mai Trin

definition: The source term used for Mai Trin after she gains powers in the Mists and channels Scarlet as her legend.
cultural_caution: A profession/power label in this character's documented context, not a collective character or assertion about every revenant build.

citations.locator: The Haunting of Mai Trin section
supports: Mai Trin's revenant powers and Scarlet-channeling description

definition: The source names Joon's effort to harness dragon magic and Ankka's experimentation with Zhaitan magic.
cultural_caution: A source-native power category; no universal magical taxonomy or complete capability list is inferred.

supports: Joon's harnessing effort, Ankka's counterforce framing, and Zhaitan-magic experimentation

definition: The source-specific formulation for Mai Trin's revenant use of Scarlet as a legend.
cultural_caution: This is neither a claim that Mai and Scarlet are the same individual nor a general rule for all revenants.

citations.locator: The Haunting of Mai Trin section
supports: Mai Trin channeling Scarlet as her legend

definition: The continent to which End of Dragons sends players and in which the Aetherblades narrative case study places its contemporary arc.
cultural_caution: A region and expansion setting, not a character culture or proof that every historical Canthan account is in this launch scope.

supports: End of Dragons journey to Cantha

definition: The in-game access route ArenaNet specifies for beginning the first End of Dragons story chapter through the Hero panel.
cultural_caution: A player interface/progression mechanic; it says nothing about a fixed player avatar identity or universal completion state.

supports: Hero-panel Story Journal access to End of Dragons's first chapter
